notes.subject: Kristy call notes — handwritten outreach history
notes.body: Kristy's notes list Utah Lake Festival and Sam Braegger, 801-753-8270, with a note suggesting no funding. Gmail history shows a much stronger relationship: in December 2023 Sam said the event was interested and asked Adventure Zone for the paid-option pricing; Adventure Zone continued outreach in 2024 and again emailed Sam for the May 30, 2026 festival. Preserve the history as a prior-interest/budget-sensitive account, not a cold lead.

followUps.label: 2027 booking follow-up
followUps.reason: Prior direct interest and repeated outreach. Revisit budget and pay-for-play/paid-package fit early for the 2027 Utah Lake Festival.
